records.materialOperation: Explain functional versus structural cellular changes from supplied findings.

records.operatorDe: vorgegebene Regel anwenden und Möglichkeiten/Grenzen erläutern
records.materialOperation: Generate connection changes from supplied activity and update rule; compare added saturation condition.
records.differenceFromGeneral: An explicit rule is applied, not just a general cellular change explained.
doesNotRequire: predict output activity without a supplied rule

records.materialOperation: Compare given persistent connection states with identical inputs; explain output difference and inhibitory counterexample.
records.modelInput: connection states plus identical test patterns and given threshold
records.differenceFromGeneral: Effects of given connection changes on network processing are compared; weights are not generated.

records.operatorDe: anhand gegebener Beschreibungen/Versuchsbefunde einordnen und erläutern
records.materialOperation: Interpret controlled time courses of strengthening, weakening, recovery and changed test conditions.
records.modelInput: authored reference data plus explicit test/control conditions
records.learnerOutput: bounded LTP/LTD-compatible inference and cellular-learning-model interpretation
records.differenceFromGeneral: Temporal empirical-model inference uses controlled same-test conditions and opposing/transient outcomes.
doesNotRequire: claim learning or forgetting by a real person
